text: Look at what the host owns here, because it is a short list.
A deck, a rim, three pipes and a conduit, a pedestal with a meter in it, maybe a ring and a column.
And it does not have to be poured.
There is no kitchen to replace.
No flooring to pull up because a ten-inch dog lived on it.
The host asset is a piece of civil engineering, and the thing most likely to damage it is weather.
